tooltip.decorator.raw_draft: Put this in a Drafting Table to refine it. You can use group or tier focus items to increase your odds of receiving Decoration Instructions from your selected group or tier when revealing the Refined Draft.
tooltip.decorator.refined_draft: Press [%1$s] while holding a Refined Draft to reveal Decoration Instructions.
tooltip.decorator.scan_template: Put inside a Decoration Scanner with any printed decoration to obtain a Decoration Scan for that decoration. The input decoration is not consumed.
tooltip.decorator.decoration_scan: Put inside a Smart 3D Printer along with the required materials to create a copy of the decoration stored on this scan. The Decoration Scan is not consumed.
tooltip.decorator.decoration_instruction: Put inside a Decoration Workbench along with the required materials to create a copy of the decoration described by these instructions. The Decoration Instructions are not consumed.
tooltip.decorator.generic_printing_paste: Put inside a 3D Printer to print a random decoration. You can use group or tier focus items to increase your odds of printing decorations from your selected group or tier.
